name: Member ID
meaning: The library's number for the member, printed on their card.

name: Name
meaning: What the member is called.

name: Email
meaning: How the library contacts the member, kept in lower case.

name: Joined at
meaning: When the member was registered.

name: Active loans
meaning: The member's loans not yet returned, at most 3.

name: Overdue
meaning: Whether any of the member's active loans is past its due date.

name: Tool ID
meaning: The library's number for the tool, written on its tag.

name: Name
meaning: What the tool is.

name: Description
meaning: Anything a borrower should know.

name: Condition
meaning: Whether the tool is fit to lend. A new tool starts good.

name: Added at
meaning: When the tool joined the catalog.

name: Status
meaning: What a borrower sees in the catalog.
type: Derived: `on_loan` while it has an active loan, else `needs_repair` when its condition is needs repair, else `available`.

name: Note
meaning: What is wrong with the tool.

name: Reported at
meaning: When the damage was reported.

name: Loan ID
meaning: The library's number for the loan.

name: Member
meaning: Who borrowed the tool.

name: Tool
meaning: Which tool was borrowed.

name: Borrowed at
meaning: When the loan started.

name: Due date
meaning: The last day of the loan, in the library's time zone.
type: Date: the borrow date in the library's time zone plus 14 days.

name: Overdue
meaning: Whether the loan is not returned and today, in the library's time zone, is after its due date.
type: Derived yes or no; never once returned.

name: Returned at
meaning: When the tool came back.

name: Condition
meaning: The tool's condition as the librarian found it.

name: Note
meaning: What the librarian noticed.

name: Late
meaning: Whether the return came on a day after the due date, in the library's time zone.
